news.headline: uniQure N.V. (NASDAQ:QURE) Receives $65.00 Consensus Price Target from Brokerages
news.summary: Brokerages covering uniQure now carry an average 12-month price target of roughly $65, reflecting a broadly bullish analyst consensus in the wake of the Q2 print and the AMT-130 regulatory progress. Coverage remains skewed toward Buy/Outperform ratings across the sell-side.

news.headline: HC Wainwright Estimates uniQure's Q3 Earnings
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright reiterated its Buy rating on uniQure with an $80 price objective, with analyst P. Trucchio modeling a Q3 2026 loss of roughly $0.90 per share ahead of the company's next report. The note underscores continued sell-side confidence heading into the planned AMT-130 BLA filing.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure to $75 from $60 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing the Q2 update and early AMT-260 epilepsy data showing meaningful seizure reductions in low-dose patients. The move added to a run of positive analyst reactions following the July 29 earnings report.

news.headline: uniQure stock upgraded by Wolfe Research on Huntington's therapy outlook
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded its rating on uniQure shares, citing an improved outlook for the AMT-130 Huntington's disease program following the company's regulatory and Q2 financial update. The upgrade added to a cluster of favorable sell-side moves in the days after the earnings print.

news.headline: uniQure (QURE): RBC Capital Maintains Confidence with Outperform Rating
news.summary: RBC Capital analyst Luca Issi maintained an Outperform rating on uniQure in a report released the same day as the company's Q2 2026 results, reaffirming confidence in the AMT-130 regulatory and commercial trajectory.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8 million and cash, equivalents and investments of $810.3 million (after a $259 million follow-on raise), sufficient to fund operations into 2030; it confirmed FDA alignment on an accelerated-approval BLA pathway for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, targeted for filing in Q3 2026, alongside a planned UK MHRA filing and early AMT-260 epilepsy data.

catalysts.label: Topline 4-year AMT-130 Phase I/II data
catalysts.detail: uniQure guided at its Q2 2026 update that topline four-year follow-up data from the ongoing Phase I/II study of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease will be released, building on the ~75% cUHDRS progression-slowing seen at the 3-year mark.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission to FDA (US)
catalysts.detail: Following FDA alignment confirmed via Type B meeting minutes, uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under the accelerated approval pathway.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 UK Marketing Authorization Application (MHRA)
catalysts.detail: Parallel filing planned with the UK's Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency for AMT-130, following a successful pre-submission meeting earlier in 2026.

catalysts.label: Additional international regulatory updates for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure has indicated it is pursuing further regulatory pathways beyond the US and UK (e.g., EMA/other markets), with updates expected in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: uniQure's next scheduled quarterly financial results and corporate update, which should also update BLA/MAA filing progress and cash runway.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 (epilepsy) Phase I/IIa data, both cohorts
catalysts.detail: Full updated safety and efficacy data across the low- and high-dose cohorts of the refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy program (AMT-260) is expected.

pulse: uniQure enters H2 2026 riding a major regulatory turnaround: after the FDA reversed course and aligned with the company on an accelerated-approval pathway for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, uniQure plans to file a US BLA and a UK MAA in Q3 2026, backed by 3-year data showing roughly 75% slowing of disease progression on the high dose. Q2 2026 results (July 29) showed cash of $810.3 million after a $259 million raise, funding operations into 2030 including the required confirmatory trial and commercial launch prep, while early pipeline readouts in Fabry disease (AMT-191) and epilepsy (AMT-260) add further optionality. The stock has rallied sharply off its 2025 lows (52-week range roughly $8.73-$71.50) and carries a Strong Buy analyst consensus with an average price target near $65-70, with topline 4-year AMT-130 data expected in September 2026 as the next major catalyst.
